Position: Painting Trades Worker
Type: Full-time
Employer: Highend Painting Services Pty Ltd
Location: Brabham WA 6055
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Highend Painting Services Pty Ltd is a reputable painting business based in Brabham, Western Australia, specialising in high-quality residential, commercial, and industrial painting services across the Perth metropolitan area. With a strong focus on precision, durability, and customer satisfaction, we deliver expert interior and exterior painting, surface preparation, protective coatings, and decorative finishes using premium materials and modern techniques. Our team prides itself on professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail, fostering a supportive workplace culture that values safety, teamwork, continuous skill development, and delivering exceptional results that enhance properties and exceed client expectations.
About the Position:
The Painting Trades Worker plays a vital role at Highend Painting Services Pty Ltd, applying paint, varnish, wallpaper, and other finishes to protect, maintain, and beautify the surfaces of buildings and structures. This full-time position involves hands-on work on a variety of projects, contributing directly to the company’s reputation for quality craftsmanship while working collaboratively within a skilled team to meet project timelines and client standards.
Key Responsibilities:
Erecting scaffolding and ladders, and placing drop sheets to protect adjacent areas from paint splattering.
Preparing surfaces by removing old paint and wallpaper, fixing woodwork, filling holes and cracks, and smoothing and sealing surfaces.
Selecting and preparing paints to required colours by mixing portions of pigment, oil, and thinning and drying additives.
Applying paints, varnishes, and stains to surfaces using brushes, rollers, and sprays.
Hanging wallpaper, matching patterns, and trimming edges.
Maintaining a safe and tidy work environment, adhering to occupational health and safety standards.
Collaborating with team members and communicating effectively with clients and supervisors.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Painting and Decorating (or equivalent).
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in painting trades.
Proven technical skills in surface preparation, paint application, colour matching, and use of painting tools and equipment.
Strong attention to detail, physical fitness, and ability to work at heights or in various conditions.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with a reliable, team-oriented attitude and commitment to safety.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Make a meaningful difference with UnitingCare Queensland 

AtUnitingCarewe are leaders in crisis response, the protection of vulnerable people and children, financialresilienceand family wellbeing. OurFaDS(Family and Disability Services) teamworkpassionately across Queensland to make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

As aSupported Living Facilitator- Planning and Admin,you'llbe encouraged to grow,developand feel empowered to make the everyday easier for the people we care so passionately about. Let'smake a meaningful difference, together!

Your part in our UnitingCare team

Provide support to people in their everyday living situations, including personal care asidentified, with a strong emphasis on choice, enhancing quality of life,healthand wellbeing, whilst ensuing duty of care is always upheld

Undertake a range of administrative functions that directly support service delivery and individual outcomes,including:basic financial and transactional activities,data capture, documentation and reporting related to case management,monitoringand supporting compliance with organisational,fundingand legislative requirements.

result.description:
We are a growing Australian business group operating across wholesale distribution, event services and education. As our organisation continues to expand and diversify, we are seeking an experienced and highly organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative and operational functions and support the continued growth of the business.

This is a senior, hands-on role suited to a proactive professional who thrives in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading office operations, developing efficient business systems, coordinating multiple business functions, and supporting strategic initiatives that drive organisational growth and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee the day-to-day office operations across multiple business divisions.
- Develop, implement and continuously improve office procedures, administrative systems and operational workflows.
- Coordinate communication and workflow across departments to ensure efficient and effective business operations.
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement initiatives that increase efficiency, streamline processes and support sustainable business growth.
- Lead the implementation, optimisation and integration of enterprise business systems, digital workflow platforms and business automation technologies.
- Coordinate supplier relationships, purchasing activities and operational logistics.
- Prepare management reports, operational documentation and business performance information to support informed decision-making.
- Assist with budgeting, resource planning and business administration.
- Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, staff administration and HR documentation.
- Maintain company policies, compliance records and organisational documentation.
- Support directors in delivering strategic projects, organisational change initiatives and business expansion activities.
- Establish scalable administrative systems and operational processes to support future growth.

Skills & Experience

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

- A minimum of three years' experience in an Office Manager, Operations Coordinator, Business Operations or similar management role.
- Demonstrated experience managing office operations within a growing, multi-site or multi-faceted business environment.
- Proven experience implementing or improving enterprise business systems, ERP, CRM or other integrated business management platforms.
- Experience leading business process improvement, workflow optimisation and automation initiatives.
- Strong organisational, project coordination and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Experience developing and maintaining business policies, procedures and operational documentation.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
- High-level computer literacy, including Microsoft 365 and cloud-based business applications.
- Experience with bookkeeping processes, reporting and business administration.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where you will play a key role in strengthening business operations, implementing scalable systems and supporting the continued growth of multiple business divisions.

If you are an experienced Office Manager looking for a challenging and rewarding role where you can make a genuine impact, we encourage you to apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

result.description:
Office Manager
Business: SAINI INDUSTRIES PTY LTD
Location: 2 Blaikie Road, Jamisontown NSW 2750
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
Full Job Description
About the Business
SAINI INDUSTRIES PTY LTD is an Australian-owned manufacturing and industrial services business based in Jamisontown, New South Wales. The company provides manufacturing, fabrication, and industrial support services to commercial and industrial clients while maintaining high standards of operational efficiency, workplace safety, and customer service.
Operating within a dynamic manufacturing environment, the business coordinates production activities, procurement, inventory management, customer service, supplier relationships, and administrative functions. As the business continues to expand, there is an increasing need for structured administrative management to ensure efficient office operations, effective communication across departments, regulatory compliance, and ongoing operational support.
To support these operational requirements, SAINI INDUSTRIES PTY LTD is seeking to appoint a dedicated full-time Office Manager.

About the Role
The Office Manager is responsible for organising and controlling the functions and resources of the office, including administrative systems, office personnel, records management, and operational support. The role is critical to ensuring the efficient administration of the business through effective planning, coordination of office services, workforce management, compliance, and continuous improvement of administrative procedures.
The successful applicant will demonstrate strong organisational, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills and be capable of managing multiple administrative priorities within a busy industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Contributing to the planning, development, review, and continuous improvement of office services, while establishing priorities and office service standards.
•	Organising and allocating office resources, including human resources, workspace, equipment, and administrative support to ensure efficient business operations.
•	Assigning work to administrative employees, monitoring work performance, and providing ongoing guidance and supervision.
•	Managing office records, administrative documentation, accounts, and confidential business information while ensuring accuracy and security.
•	Liaising with management, accountants, suppliers, contractors, customers, and other professionals to coordinate office activities and facilitate the resolution of operational issues.
•	Ensuring office equipment, facilities, and supplies are properly maintained, serviced, and replenished.
•	Monitoring compliance with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements and promoting safe administrative practices.
•	Ensuring office operations comply with relevant Commonwealth and State legislation, organisational policies, and company procedures.
•	Coordinating personnel activities including recruitment, onboarding, payroll administration, performance management, staff training, promotions, leave administration, and supervision.
•	Preparing reports, maintaining administrative systems, supporting budgeting processes, and recommending improvements to enhance office efficiency and operational performance.

Requirements
Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.
Applicants should possess:
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma, or Diploma in Business Administration, Office Management, Management, or a closely related discipline.
OR
•	At least three years of relevant work experience may substitute for formal qualifications.
Applicants should also demonstrate:
•	Experience in office management or a similar administrative leadership position.
